newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH 1996 CROP UP 11 PCT TO 3.7 MLN TONNES.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH 1996 CROP UP 11 PCT TO 3.7 MLN TONNES.

text.p: Finland's total crop this year was 11 percent higher than last year at a higher-than-average 3.7 million tonnes, the Ministry of Forestry and Agriculture said on Monday.
Barley yields totalled 1.86 million tonnes, up five percent on 1995, and oat yields rose 14 percent to 1.26 million tonnes, it said in a statement.
The fodder crop rose nine percent, in line with the increase in areas cultivated, to 3.16 million tonnes.
The bread grain crop totalled 546 million kg, up 109 million with wheat yields well above average.
"Before threshing, there were hopes for top yields in some areas but the harvested volumes turned out slightly below estimates," the ministry said.
The season was characterised by a cold, damp start in early summer and a hot dry August, and the main reason for the increase was a 100,000 hectare expansion of farming area, it said.
The potato crop fell four percent to 770 million kg and sugarbeet fell some 20 percent to 897 million kg, it said.
